name: Service Metal Fabricating Inc
old_description: We embrace advanced manufacturing technologies to help our customers stay ahead. From automated cutting and precision machining to industrial finishing and testing, SMF’s solutions are built to optimize quality, durability, and performance.
about:
Service Metal Fabricating Inc operates from Rockaway, New Jersey. The company traces its roots to 1981, when it was founded on a passion for craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. Over four decades later, it remains a privately held business serving clients across the United States.

The shop provides end-to-end metal fabrication, including CNC milling (3-, 4-, and 5-axis), CNC turning with live tooling, laser and waterjet cutting, robotic welding, powder coating, plating, and mechanical and electromechanical assembly. Its 100,000-square-foot facility houses all processes under one roof, enabling prototype-to-production runs for millions of parts annually across 500-plus clients.

Customers span more than 30 industries, notably aerospace and defense, medical devices, biotech, semiconductor, food and beverage, architectural and structural, oil and gas, and heavy equipment such as semi-trucks and trailers. The company highlights work on the 9/11 Memorial plaques in New York as a past project.

SMF emphasizes its integrated facility, advanced equipment, and a quality mindset backed by ISO-certified processes. Design-for-manufacturability reviews, in-house finishing, and skilled technicians are cited as keys to repeatable precision and faster turnaround.
